description: The Go To Stratum visual links together the data on your Power BI Desktop with related outside information using URL access. Quickly and seamlessly move from a high-level visualization in your Power BI dashboard to a website that displays detail data that drives greater insights and supplies actionable information. To do that, simply identify a “Field That Contains URL” for the Go To Stratum visual by selecting the applicable data field from the Data pane. This field will be used to open a new browser tab when the user selects an associated value in a Power BI visual. Click the configured Go To Stratum visual whenever you need to see the linked data. For any feature requests or questions about this visual send an email to our team at info@Silvon.com.
